newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot natgas prices ease ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot natgas prices ease ahead of holiday.

text.p: U.S. spot natgas prices headed lower Thursday ahead of the holiday weekend and cooler forecasts in the East and Midwest, but most traders said they had expected a sharper downward move.
"Supplies were actually tight at the end. Everyone was expecting it to crater, but it just didn't happen," one gas trader said.
On the Louisiana Gulf Coast, prices were quoted slightly lower around $2.11 per mmBtu at the Henry Hub as temperatures along the Gulf Coast soared to highs well into the 90s F.

One reason for the stronger-than-expected market, traders said, was the American Gas Association's storage data, indicating stocks were up 76 bcf last week. This was well below previous estimates at 85-95 bcf.

Overall stocks were still 216 bcf, or 16 percent, over year-ago levels. Producing region inventories remained 52 percent over 1996 levels. Western stocks continued to lag year-ago levels by nine percent.

Meanwhile in the East, where gas stocks climbed 56 bcf to 11 percent above year-ago levels, swing prices at the New York city-gate slipped several cents to the mid-$2.30s as traders anticipated a significant drop in demand over the holiday weekend.
Temperatures in the Mid-Atlantic states were expected to return to about three to five degrees above normal early next week following a seasonably warm weekend, Weather Services Corp (WSC) said.
Permian prices fell about 10 cents to a wide range of $1.85-1.96 due to the sharp drop in demand from southern California over the holiday weekend.
San Juan prices also felt the brunt of the weaker demand as deals were reported done in the high-$1.70s to low-$1.80s for Bondad gas.

The 1,070 megawatt San Onofre 2 nuclear unit remained off line and was expected to return to service by mid-month. The adjacent unit 3, with a generating capacity of 1,080 MW, was slated to restart July 12, according to the company.
In the Midwest, swing prices fell an average of four cents to the high-$1.90s, with Chicago city-gate talked around $2.14-2.15.
